future_check: If raw_code is ever promoted to selected authority, synchronize all active copies atomically and rerun 3/3 canonical execution parity.
rationale: The active selected authorities diverged before repair even though all source texts executed correctly. Exact selected synchronization removes ambiguity; preserving raw_code avoids an unnecessary style rewrite and retains provenance.
summary: Synchronize selected target_code exactly to canonical while preserving the comment-rich raw_code as archival executable source.

future_check: After any morphology change, rerun strict defect lint, distribution gate, and the executable canonical profile extractor.
rationale: The baseline generated a median maximum object size below the canonical profile and split the foreground into five components. A connected sparse shape preserves non-solid row texture while matching the canonical one-component morphology.
summary: Use one connected canonical-scale symmetric shape instead of the original tiny fragmented bracket.

future_check: Keep structural negatives in focused mutation tests only; ordinary AXES must remain observable and self-check-valid.
rationale: Those modes violate the task grammar and created thousands of override/self-check failures. They are useful negative fixtures, not lawful training axes.
summary: Do not expose no-shape, no-occluder, or full-grid negatives as ordinary texture overrides.

future_check: Continue reporting oracle executability and generator-lawfulness as separate evidence.
rationale: The negative recombination probe is rejected by self_check because it destroys the unique shape/rectangle grammar. Oracle execution alone does not certify lesson validity.
summary: A recombined scene can be executable by the oracle while still invalid for the teaching distribution.

future_check: Keep the two-demo shortcut-refutation test whenever the schedule or LESSON_COMPETITORS changes.
rationale: Independent random branch draws can leave a lesson compatible with side-specific or between-column-only shortcuts. The sample-index schedule makes branch support deterministic without coupling output to global RNG state.
summary: Cycle four profiles so each consecutive two-demo window contains both occluder sides and both symmetry-axis parities.
